pages.text: $(l)Pelorovis$() - a buffalo too big for the word, with horns two metres across. Herds of three to five graze the open grass.$(br2)It starts nothing. Strike a healthy one and it turns on you, and the herd comes with it.

Wear it past half its strength and it breaks and runs - and then it is a persistence hunt like any other, with a great deal more at the end: meat, hides, bone, and a large carcass.$(br2)Erectus must bring down one of the megafauna - a Pelorovis, or one of the great predators - to go further.
